# Visit Rome Pass

> > Visit Rome Pass is a customizable city pass providing skip-the-line access to 50+ Rome attractions including the Colosseum, Vatican Museums, and public transport.

The platform offers a tailored pass builder ("Tailor Trip") allowing tourists to create personalized itineraries for major Rome landmarks like the Pantheon, Roman Forum, Palatine Hill, St. Peter's Basilica, and Sistine Chapel. Operated by D&D Distribuzione Titoli di Viaggio, the service provides digital vouchers and multi-day pass options with integrated public transport access.

## Key Topics

- Visit Rome Pass
- Colosseum skip-the-line access
- Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
- Customizable tourist pass builder
- Rome public transport integration
- Digital voucher booking
- Roman Forum and Palatine Hill
- St. Peter's Basilica

- Rome in Golf Cart tours

## Pass Builder & Core Features

- [Visit Rome Pass Tailor](https://www.visitromepass.eu/tailortrip-visit-rome-pass): Customizable Rome city pass with Colosseum and Vatican skip-the-line
- [Créé ton Pass (French)](https://www.visitromepass.eu/fr/tailortrip-visit-rome-pass): French customizable Rome Pass builder for Colosseum and Vatican Museums
- [Erstelle deinen Pass (German)](https://www.visitromepass.eu/de/tailortrip-visit-rome-pass): German custom pass creator for Rome attractions and public transport
- [Crea il tuo Pass (Italian)](https://www.visitromepass.eu/it/tailortrip-visit-rome-pass): Italian custom pass builder for Colosseo, Foro Romano, and Vatican
- [Crea tu Pass (Spanish)](https://www.visitromepass.eu/es/tailortrip-visit-rome-pass): Spanish customizable Rome Pass with Coliseo and transport included
